query:
SELECT
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(amount)
                FROM entries
                WHERE account_id = $1 AND asset_code = $2
            ), 0)::BIGINT
            -
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(l.amount)
                FROM legs l
                JOIN proposals p ON p.id = l.proposal_id
                JOIN approvals a ON a.proposal_id = l.proposal_id AND a.account_id = l.from_id
                WHERE l.from_id = $1
                  AND l.asset_code = $2
                  AND a.decision = 'approved'
                  AND p.state = 'pending'
                  AND p.expires_at > now()
            ), 0)::BIGINT
            AS "available!"
